title: Bukit Bintang to KLIA2: The Bus from Lalaport BBCC
metaDescription: Flying out of KLIA2 from Bukit Bintang? Take the airport bus from the Lalaport hub, the Monorail and KLIA Ekspres, or a taxi. Where to board and what to check.

contentBlocks.content: From Bukit Bintang to KLIA2 you have three choices. The airport bus leaves from the Lalaport Transportation Hub, an indoor terminal at LaLaport BBCC next to Hang Tuah station, and drops you at the airport. The train means taking the Monorail to KL Sentral and changing to the KLIA Ekspres, which reaches KLIA2 in about 33 minutes. A taxi or Grab picks you up at your hotel. The bus suits travellers with time and bags, the train suits anyone who wants a fixed timetable, and a car suits families and early flights.
Key Takeaways
Is there a bus from Bukit Bintang to KLIA2? Yes. Buses leave from the Lalaport Transportation Hub at LaLaport BBCC, on LG1 of the East Atrium. Book them on ttklia.com.
Is there a bus to KLIA Terminal 1 too? Yes, from the same hub. Check which terminal your flight uses before you book.
What about the train? Take the Monorail from Hang Tuah or Bukit Bintang station to KL Sentral, then the KLIA Ekspres. The Ekspres costs RM55 for an adult.
Where does Grab pick up at Lalaport? The mall points to LaLaport Drop Off 2 at the Jalan Hang Tuah entrance.
By bus from the Lalaport hub

The Lalaport Transportation Hub is a city centre stop for airport buses. It is open 24 hours, on Level LG1 of the East Atrium of LaLaport BBCC, and linked to Hang Tuah LRT and Monorail station by a covered walkway (LaLaport BBCC). Shuttle vans to KLIA Terminal 1 and KLIA2 also leave from here.

Book your seat before you go and keep the ticket on your phone. The booking shows the operator, the departure time and the journey time. At the hub, check in, wait in the air conditioned lounge, and watch the departure screens for your bay. If you are checking out of your hotel early, the hub's lockers hold your bags for up to 24 hours. Our Lalaport Transportation Hub guide shows the way in from the train.

content.heading: Flying from KLIA2? Take the bus from Lalaport
content.subheading: Airport buses from the Lalaport Transportation Hub in Bukit Bintang to KLIA2. Choose your date and time on ttklia.com.

contentBlocks.content: Flying from KLIA Terminal 1 instead

KLIA2 and KLIA Terminal 1 are separate terminals. Your booking or boarding pass names yours. If it is Terminal 1, take the Lalaport to KLIA Terminal 1 bus instead. Booked the wrong one? Our KLIA1 to KLIA2 guide explains the transfer between terminals.
By train: Monorail and KLIA Ekspres

From Hang Tuah station, the KL Monorail runs to KL Sentral at the end of the line. From Bukit Bintang Monorail station, ride the same line south through Imbi and Hang Tuah. At KL Sentral, follow the signs to the KLIA Ekspres.

The KLIA Ekspres runs from KL Sentral to KLIA Terminal 1 in 28 minutes, then after a short stop reaches KLIA2 3 minutes later, about 33 minutes in all. A single ticket is RM55 for adults and RM25 for children aged 6 to 15, and buying online or in the app takes 10% off (KLIA Ekspres, checked 3 October 2026). Trains run every 20 minutes for most of the day. Late at night they stop at every station, so allow more time.

The train is a good choice with a light bag and a fixed flight time. With two large suitcases, the Monorail stairs and the change at KL Sentral add effort. Our KLIA2 to KL Sentral guide has the full fare table.
By taxi or Grab

A car picks you up at your hotel and drops you at departures. Grab fares change with demand, so check the price in the app before you commit. If you are leaving from Lalaport, the mall names LaLaport Drop Off 2, the Jalan Hang Tuah entrance, as its closest e-hailing point (LaLaport BBCC).
For a fixed price booked ahead, see our guides to a taxi to KLIA and to airport transfers in Kuala Lumpur.

Whichever you choose, give yourself a margin. Roads out of KL are slower at rush hour, so leave early.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I get from Bukit Bintang to KLIA2 by bus?

Take the airport bus from the Lalaport Transportation Hub at LaLaport BBCC, next to Hang Tuah station. It is a short ride from Bukit Bintang on the Monorail. Book your seat on ttklia.com and board on LG1.
Can I take the train from Bukit Bintang to KLIA2?

Yes. Take the KL Monorail from Bukit Bintang or Hang Tuah station to KL Sentral, then the KLIA Ekspres to KLIA2. The Ekspres takes about 33 minutes from KL Sentral to KLIA2 and costs RM55 for an adult.
Is KLIA2 the same as KLIA Terminal 1?
No. KLIA2 and KLIA Terminal 1 are separate terminals at the same airport. Check your booking, then take the matching bus from Lalaport.
Where is the airport bus stop in Bukit Bintang?
The airport bus stop in Bukit Bintang is the Lalaport Transportation Hub, on Level LG1, East Atrium, of LaLaport BBCC at No. 2 Jalan Hang Tuah. It is open 24 hours.
Conclusion

From Bukit Bintang to KLIA2, take the bus from the Lalaport hub if you have bags and time, the Monorail and KLIA Ekspres if you want a fixed timetable, and a taxi if you are a family or flying early. Check your terminal first, then book your Lalaport to KLIA2 bus on ttklia.com.
